message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to incoming data; ImageFolder and CASIADataset are used directly without validation logic.
No detected untrusted source handling: All data is loaded from hardcoded local filesystem paths with no checksum verification, signed URLs, or authentication of any remote source.

No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparison, label value validation against an expected set, or noise-detection tooling (e.g., Cleanlab) is present anywhere in the data preparation path.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The data loading code applies only standard augmentation and normalization transforms; there is no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checking, or filtering of suspicious training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads finetune model weights via paths provided as command-line arguments (finetune_model_path, finetune_head_path) with no hash checks, signature verification, or pinned revisions visible in the provided code.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, validates the expected label set, or detects anomalous training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No backdoor defense mechanisms such as trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection are present anywhere in the training code.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses standard PyTorch optimizers with no Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, or any DP-SGD integration.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or robustness stress tests are referenced anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set isolated from training data, hashed/signed evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics to guard against manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: The code applies standard torchvision transforms (normalization, random flip) for training but there is no explicit input shape/range validation or malformed input rejection on the inference path.

No detected output bounds checks: No code is visible that checks model outputs for NaN values, out-of-range probabilities, or calibrated confidence thresholds before returning results at inference time.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a face recognition/verification model (not an LLM), so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
